Subject: NebulaWorks private deployment: network alignment & rollout checkpoints

Hi Samira / Raj —

Thanks for choosing Redwood for your private deployment. I’m Hannah (CSM) and I’ll be coordinating the handoff to our implementation team. To keep things tight we want to confirm networking and rollout checkpoints before the technical kickoff.

High-level asks (please see attached draft network CIDR and our initial MAP):
- Confirm the VPC CIDR(s) you plan to peer with (attach nebula-network-cidr.xlsx if available)
- Preferred AWS region for peering and expected egress patterns
- Whether you’ll use VPC peering or PrivateLink/private endpoints for control-plane traffic
- Any corporate firewall egress IP allowlist and VPN cert thumbprint for mutual-auth
- On-prem appliance readiness (expected rack space, public IP, and inbound rules) — we have redwood-onprem-package-specs.pdf attached for hardware guidance

Proposed next steps:
1) You share the CIDR + preferred region and a primary technical contact (IT Ops) — by EOD Thu 10/23
2) 30–45m technical kickoff with implementation team next week (availability matrix below)
3) We’ll circulate a mutual action plan with owners + dates (we’ll attach a working MAP)

Availability for kickoff (PT): Mon 10/26 10:00–12:00, Tue 10/27 09:00–11:30 or Wed 10/28 13:00–15:00. Let me know what works.

Attachments: nebula-network-draft.pdf (draft CIDR + diagram), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (template)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

--
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Hannah —

Thanks — excited to get started. Quick answers below and I attached the CIDR sheet.

- Primary technical contact: Raj Patel (cc’d) and IT Ops (itops@nebulaworks.com)
- CIDRs: 10.40.0.0/16 (prod), 10.41.0.0/16 (staging) — see attached nebula-network-cidr.xlsx
- Preferred region: us-west-2 for low-latency to our app tier
- Control-plane: prefer PrivateLink for control-plane endpoints (we’re standardizing on private endpoints)
- Egress: outbound to S3 and telemetry endpoints via NAT gateway; we will provide a firewall rule list and public egress IPs by Fri 10/24
- On-prem appliance: target install week of 11/9 — hardware inventory and rack PDU details will come from IT Ops next week

We can do Tue 10/27 09:30 PT for the kickoff. Please send calendar invite.

Two quick asks ahead of the call: please add the VPN cert thumbprint (if mutual-auth) or the public egress IPs to the CIDR sheet; and if you prefer PrivateLink we'll surface the control-plane endpoint DNS expectations.
